name: h5-mainroom
description: TEMPLATE (i) v0.31.8.37: tpl-hdb-5room's front door opened into the MASTER BEDROOM, and its south wall is lined only by the master, master bath and balcony — so no offset there is correct. Asserts the door now fronts the living room and screenshots the plan.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-every-room-reachable
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState().floorPlan; const m=s.openings.find(o=>o.id==='h5-main'); if(!m) throw new Error('no h5-main'); if(m.wallId!=='h5-n') throw new Error('h5-main is on '+m.wallId); const w=s.walls.find(x=>x.id==='h5-n'); const ux=(w.end[0]-w.start[0]), len=Math.hypot(ux, w.end[1]-w.start[1]); const x0=w.start[0]+ux/len*m.offset, x1=w.start[0]+ux/len*(m.offset+m.width); const liv=s.rooms.find(r=>r.id==='h5-living'); const inLiv=Math.min(x0,x1)>=liv.origin[0]&&Math.max(x0,x1)<=liv.origin[0]+liv.width; if(!inLiv) throw new Error('door x '+x0.toFixed(2)+'-'+x1.toFixed(2)+' not inside the living '+liv.origin[0]+'-'+(liv.origin[0]+liv.width)); return 'front door at x '+x0.toFixed(2)+'-'+x1.toFixed(2)+', inside Living / Dining'})()
